title: Scanner Code Reconciliation
brief: Our warehouse scanners read product codes off worn labels, and the reads are sometimes garbled. To score how badly a read went, we measure how many single-character fixes turn the scanned code into the true code.

A fix inserts one character, deletes one character, or replaces one character with another. Implement fewestCharacterFixes(word1, word2), where word1 is the scanned code and word2 is the true code, and return the smallest number of fixes that turns word1 into word2.
